description_en: Retrieves the list of pending automated O&M approval requests
description_zh: 获取待处理的自动运维审批列表
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-todo-ops-task-approvals --instance-id bastionhost-cn-m413tuhlo03 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTodoOpsTaskApprovals

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The task name or task remarks to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的任务名称或任务备注。模糊查询
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The task scheduling type used to filter results. Valid values:
FixTime: scheduled execution.
CycleInterval: periodic execution.
Manual: manually triggered by the user
parameters.help_zh:
按任务调度类型查询。取值范围：
FixTime：定时执行。
CycleInterval：周期执行。
Manual：由用户手动触发执行
parameters.name: schedule_type

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query.  
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. The default number of entries per page is 20. If PageSize is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。  
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

ApplyAt.description_en: The time when the request was submitted, in seconds (UNIX timestamp)
ApplyAt.description_zh: 提交申请的时间（秒，时间戳格式）

ApproveId.description_en: The approval ID of the O&M task

ClientName.description_en: The username of the O&M task applicant
ClientName.description_zh: 运维任务申请人用户名

ClientUid.description_en: The bastion host user ID of the applicant
ClientUid.description_zh: 提交申请的堡垒机用户ID

Comment.description_en: The remarks of the O&M task

Name.description_en: The name of the O&M task

ScheduleType.description_en:
The scheduling type of the task.
FixTime: scheduled execution.
CycleInterval: periodic execution.
Manual: manually triggered by the user
ScheduleType.description_zh:
任务的调度类型。
FixTime：定时执行。
CycleInterval：周期执行。
Manual：由用户手动触发执行

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the O&M task

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of approval records returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的审批记录总数量
